full_judgment: 8. It appears that the convict petitioner was not present in the court on the date of Judgment due to his sickness but subsequently he surrendered on 23.01.2007. Therefore, the convict petitioner could not prefer any appeal within 30 days, the statutory period of limitation. The convict-petitioner invoked the jurisdiction of this court under section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure for quashment of the judgment and order of conviction and sentence passed by the Tribunal and obtained the, present Rule.
